research_notes: A future aggregate should distinguish elapsed wall time from model-active reasoning time because tool latency contributes to invocation lifetime.
For operational safety, wall-clock elapsed is the controlling quantity even when some time is external I/O latency.
For utilization optimization, useful-work attribution may separately discount pure waiting while still counting necessary I/O.
This study therefore records both elapsed and active-work estimates where possible.
Generated analytical/checkpoint operations are operationally representative because the target relay actually depends on durable I/O.
The strict target remains a wall-clock runtime class.
